maya: Quick sync — candidate for Infra Eng (take-home + onsite) scheduled for Thu 3/26 11:00 PT. Can the panel below confirm availability and a lead for debrief?

samir: I can do 11:00 PT. happy to lead debrief.

jordan: I’m good — prefer to cover system design portion.

emily: I can do 11 but need to step out 11:30–11:45. can I do the first 30m?

rachel: I’m out that day, can cover as backup if needed.

maya: Thanks — @emily that works. plan: 11:00–11:30 coding (Emily lead), 11:30–12:00 system design (Jordan), 12:00–12:15 culture + Qs (Samir).

maya: Small rubric ask — we’ve been getting mixed signals on "ownership vs runtime ops" in the infra rubric. please use these two separate axes when scoring:
- technical depth (1–4) — how well candidate reasons about tradeoffs, complexity, tradeoffs
- ops maturity (1–4) — monitoring, rollback, SLAs, incident playbooks

samir: Agreed. for ops maturity please call out concrete examples in the comment box (e.g., monitoring signal + runbook).

jordan: Quick clarifying Q: for coding, is partial implementation + clear plan = 3 or 4?

emily: We decided earlier: correctness + tests = 4; partial + good design = 3. I'll paste the rubric snippet after this.

emily: ```
Scoring guide (short):
4 - Complete solution, tests, clear edge-case handling, operational considerations.
3 - Solid design, partial implementation, good tradeoffs, some edge cases noted.
2 - Basic approach, missing key tradeoffs, limited ops thinking.
1 - Incorrect or no workable plan.
```

maya: Also: debrief form link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/ops/debrief-form (please fill within 24h).

maya: Logistics: candidate will use our Lambda cluster for coding kata, ask them to bring their laptop; we’ll provide VPN + temp account.

jordan: Tiny note: when scoring, use the dropdown labels (tech, ops, collaboration) — include short bullet examples.

rachel: If someone needs to swap, reply here ASAP. I can take coding if Emily truly can’t make first 30.

interview-bot: Reminder scheduled — 24h prior reminder queued to panel for Thu 3/25 11:00 PT.

maya: Perfect — thanks all. see you Thu. :thumbsup:
